title: Rivet component
description: Adds a resumability-correct component (.tsx) to a Rivet app or library: inline-arrow handlers, render-function children for overlays, plus a test and an optional story route.

directory.description: Folder under the project's src (default components for apps, the src root for libraries).

kind.description: basic: signal + inline handler; overlay: trigger + panel with render-function children.

test.description: Write <Name>.test.tsx. Default: when the project has a vitest config.

export.description: Re-export from the library's src/index.ts. Default: true for libraries.
